# Mail

> Saved player inbox with claimable reward attachments.

- Package: `Mail` · Category: Economy & items
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Data](Data.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Mail")` on the server

## `GaxiaServer.Mail`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/MailService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Mail = GaxiaServer.Mail
```

### Functions

- `Mail.Send(toPlayer: Player, input: MailInput): string`
- `Mail.GetMailbox(player: Player): { Mail }`
- `Mail.GetUnreadCount(player: Player): number`
- `Mail.MarkRead(player: Player, mailId: string): boolean`
- `Mail.Claim(player: Player, mailId: string): (any?, string?)`
  Hand back the attachments once; marks the mail read + claimed.
- `Mail.Delete(player: Player, mailId: string): boolean`

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Mail.OnReceive` — `Signal<Player, Mail?>`
  (player, mail) after Send stored the mail in the recipient's mailbox (mail is nil when the inbox cap trimmed the new mail straight away)
